title: Review pre-built bracket for FDM concerns
task: A project already contains a bracket with: wall thickness 0.6 mm on one rib, a 1.2 mm hole, and a large horizontal overhang when oriented as-built. Review the model for consumer FDM printability. Identify relevant concerns, label any numeric guidance as contextual (printer/material dependent), state assumptions, and recommend verification. Do not invent universal manufacturing constants. Optional: apply a modest corrective feature only if clearly justified, then re-validate.
